definitions.explanation: A nut with a spiny husk, or the tree that produces it. Chestnuts are a beloved autumn ingredient in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{栗|くり}{拾|ひろ}いに{行|い}く。
examples.english: When autumn comes, we go chestnut gathering.

examples.japanese: {栗|くり}ご{飯|はん}は{秋|あき}の{味覚|みかく}だ。
examples.english: Chestnut rice is an autumn delicacy.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}の{香|かお}りがする。

notes:
{栗|くり} refers to chestnuts and chestnut trees.

Common expressions:
- {栗|くり}ご{飯|はん} (chestnut rice)
- {栗|くり}{拾|ひろ}い (chestnut gathering)
- {焼|や}き{栗|ぐり} (roasted chestnuts)
- {甘栗|あまぐり} (sweet roasted chestnuts)
- {栗|くり}きんとん (sweetened chestnut paste)
- {栗|くり}{色|いろ} (chestnut brown color)
- {毬栗|いがぐり} (chestnut in its spiny husk; also describes spiky hair)

Counter: {個|こ}

Cultural note:
Chestnuts are an important autumn ingredient in Japan. {栗|くり}ご{飯|はん} and {栗|くり}きんとん (often served at New Year's) are seasonal favorites. {栗|くり}きんとん from Nakatsugawa in Gifu is particularly famous. {甘栗|あまぐり} (Tianjin chestnuts) roasted and sold by street vendors are a popular snack.
